programmes.title: Certificate in Ministry
programmes.summary: Foundation Year (Semester 1 & 2). Build strong spiritual and biblical foundations for effective ministry.
programmes.description: The Foundation Year grounds you in the whole of Scripture, sound interpretation and the core doctrines of the faith, laying a strong, grace-based foundation for a lifetime of effective, Spirit-filled ministry.
outcomes: Understand the storyline of the Bible from Genesis to Revelation
Read and interpret Scripture using sound, context-based principles
Explain the core doctrines of the Christian faith with confidence
Build a firm foundation for growth in ministry and leadership

modules.title: Bible Survey
lessons: The life of Jesus and the early church

modules.title: The Core Doctrines
lessons: God, Jesus and the Holy Spirit
The church and the last things

programmes.title: Diploma in Ministry & Leadership
programmes.summary: Advanced Training (Semester 3 & 4). Develop leadership skills and practical ministry experience for greater impact.
programmes.description: The Advanced Training year develops Christlike leadership, vision and practical ministry competence, equipping you to build teams, preach and teach, and serve the local church and the nations with greater impact.
syllabus: The Heart of a Servant Leader
outcomes: Lead from Christlike character and a servant's heart
Cast and communicate a clear, God-given vision
Build, develop and empower healthy ministry teams
Preach, teach and minister in the gifts of the Spirit with wisdom

programmes.title: Practical, Spiritual & Transformational
programmes.summary: Biblical Teaching, Leadership Development, Ministry Practicum, Mentorship and Outreach woven through the whole programme.
programmes.description: This practical track runs alongside your studies, turning teaching into transformation through hands-on ministry practicum, personal mentorship and real outreach, so you are prepared, equipped and empowered for life, ministry and leadership.
outcomes: Apply biblical truth in real ministry settings
Grow through personal mentorship and accountability
Serve in hands-on ministry practicum and outreach
Be prepared, equipped and empowered for Kingdom impact
